[[File:EmpiresStationIIDathomir.jpg|230px|thumb|Empire's Station II in the Dathomir system]]

'''Empire's Station II''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]] belonging to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="JTL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>

{{Station-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Empire's Station II was a location in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], the [[2004]] expansion pack for the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="JTL" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
